item.text: The web view uses `display_name` to collapse whitespace and return `"Anonymous"` for empty names. I’ll reuse that helper while preserving the API’s `{"label": ...}` response shape.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import unittest

path = Path('api.py')
old = 'def customer_label(name):\\n    return {\"label\": name}\\n'
new = 'from labels import display_name\\n\\ndef customer_label(name):\\n    return {\"label\": display_name(name)}\\n'
source = path.read_text()
assert source.count(old) == 1, 'Expected one exact source match'
path.write_text(source.replace(old, new, 1))

from api import customer_label
from web import customer_heading
cases = [
    ('Lee', 'Lee'),
    ('  Lee  ', 'Lee'),
    ('  Mary   Jane  ', 'Mary Jane'),
    ('\\tMary\\nJane\\r\\n', 'Mary Jane'),
    ('\\u2003Mary\\u00a0Jane\\u2003', 'Mary Jane'),
    ('', 'Anonymous'),
    (' \\t\\n\\r\\u2003', 'Anonymous'),
]
for name, expected in cases:
    assert customer_label(name) == {'label': expected}, repr(name)
    assert customer_label(name)['label'] == customer_heading(name), repr(name)
print(f'Passed {len(cases)} name-formatting and web-parity cases', flush=True)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('.', pattern='test_sample.py'))
if not result.wasSuccessful():
    raise SystemExit(1)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--', 'api.py'], check=True)
PY"
